olivia (Design): Hey team — quick copy review request. Permission modal for third-party integrations. Screenshot: https://img.redwood.dev/s/perm-modal.png sam (Product): Thanks — quick Q: is this modal shown to org admins only? olivia (Design): Yes, admin flow only. We want the action button verb to be clear about granting runtime access to models and logs. Current draft says "Allow" which feels weak. mike (DevEx): Strong agree. "Allow" is ambiguous. Options: "Authorize", "Grant access", "Enable integration". Also think about token/credential wording. leanne (A11y): Important: screen reader will read the modal title + button label. Recommend button text be concise but include the subject in the title/description rather than the button. E.g., title: "Grant Redwood access to Acme Model" and button: "Authorize". Also ensure focus goes to the primary action. olivia (Design): Putting three variants here — pick one or suggest edits: 1) Title: "Grant access to Acme Model" / Body: "This integration will have runtime access to generated outputs and logs." Button primary: "Authorize" / Secondary: "Cancel" 2) Title: "Authorize Acme integration" / Body: "Acme will be able to call models and view call logs for debugging." Button primary: "Grant access" / Secondary: "Keep closed" (non-standard) 3) Title: "Enable integration" / Body: "Enable data exchange between Redwood and Acme for model orchestration." Button primary: "Enable" / Secondary: "Not now" sam (Product): I prefer 1 for clarity. Suggest changing secondary from "Cancel" to "Back" because hitting escape should be explicit. Also for legal/regulatory customers we may need "Grant access (read logs)"? maybe too long. mike (DevEx): Don't make the primary overly long. Short + punchy is fine. For telemetry we should include a link to "What this means" in the body. Also dev note: button style should use the default primary color, not destructive (this is a grant, not delete). leanne (A11y): For screen reader users: add aria-describedby on the primary that points to the body ID. Example snippet: ```html

Grant access to Acme Model

This integration will have runtime access to generated outputs and logs. What this means

``` olivia (Design): Nice — updated copy suggestion combining feedback: Title: "Grant access to Acme Model" Body: "This integration will be able to call your models and view call logs for debugging." + link "What this means" Primary: "Authorize" (aria-describedby -> body) Secondary: "Back" mike (DevEx): +1. One tiny nit: use sentence-case on the body and title, and keep primary button sentence-case too ("Authorize" not "AUTHORIZE"). Also add a small subtext under the title for org-only visibility: "Visible to admins in Acme org". sam (Product): I'm happy with that. Approving wording and accessibility snippet. :thumbsup: deploy-bot: Note: will need translation keys for i18n: perm.title, perm.body, perm.primary, perm.secondary olivia (Design): Great — thanks all. I'll push the updated figma frame and add the aria snippet to the implementation ticket. sam (Product): Approved — go ahead. :white_check_mark:
